title: Jagged Venezuelan Casserole
description: A twist on traditional Venezuelan cuisine, this casserole combines jagged potatoes with a flavorful casserole sauce.
instructions: Peel and chop jagged potatoes into 1-inch pieces.
In a large skillet, heat light oil over medium heat.
Add chopped potatoes and cook until slightly tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in casserole sauce and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Transfer potato mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
